item.title: 25 Years of Broadcasting
item.description: Today, January 12th, marks 25 years of broadcasting on the FM dial. Local FM was granted a broadcasting license in 2000 and went on air for the first time in early 2001. It’s business as usual today, but we couldn’t let the milestone pass without highlighting the day. Thank you to anyone who has ever volunteered, listened or contributed in any way.
